integration_notes: S05 was cleanly rebuilt directly from the immutable v1-contract-r3 base 99279d082938dce2a0cdd65f99835cf69571ae84; implementation commit 66f61b224ced4a9a9639c25aeb604bb36ef97428 has a complete tree, blob set, and file-mode set exactly equivalent to archived implementation reference bd811cb9b7b395c0b7de10d6a23ed025ee028fcc, without incorporating that reference or any invalid archived commit into the new ancestry.
CCR-S05-001 and the later r3 application-facing state, Coordinator, submission retry, parking, and Runtime error closures are resolved by v1-contract-r3; S05 has no remaining contract change request.

JobControlPort normal claim competition remains ClaimReceipt(claimed=false); ApplicationPortError is propagated unchanged for the frozen method-level business and state errors and no Coordinator business error enters the transient storage retry set.

JobControlPort.submit_outcome retries only the exact public method-specific set and always reuses the same finalized RuntimeExecutionReceipt objects in-process; EXECUTION_RECORD_FAILED remains globally non-retryable outside that method-specific first-publication channel.

ASSET_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE and CONFIG_INVALID preserve the finalized outbox and fail readiness without backoff or Runtime re-execution; restart recovery rehydrates and submits the same canonical receipt after repair.

Runtime.execute STATE_CORRUPT and STATE_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED stop claiming and readiness with Runtime=1, submit=0, report=0, and backoff=0; the RUNNING Job is left for repaired startup recovery to interrupt.

Fatal worker callbacks complete before idle becomes observable, while cancellation is retired and claiming is disabled before the callback; measured_max_agent_concurrency=1 across ROUTE, DIAGNOSE, REVIEW, and different Cases.
Nullable post-commit case_view projections are accepted only after exact persisted processing or failure identity gates; a null projection cannot bypass recovery persistence verification.
S05 constructs no Workspace attachment input, so the r3 filename_suffix addition has no S05 production construction site; r3 state schema faults are consumed only through frozen Ports.
S05 creates no persistence timestamps, so no Clock is consumed here; runtime epoch IDs use the injected IdGenerator and all waits and failure points are injectable.
